title.narrative: Community-led drought response project in Laisamis and Moyale sub counties.

description.narrative: CIFA intends to implement drought response intervention project for two months response program. This will be done through multi-purpose Cash transfer for 280 most vulnerable households, GBV Response and Dignity Kit Support in areas worst hit by the drought in Laisamis, Korr/Ngurinit wards of Laisamis Sub County and in Moyale Sub County, wards of Butiye, Golbo and Obbu will be considered for interventions. According to the February 2026 SRA accessment report, it was observed and reccomended that proportion of population in an urgent non-conditional cash transfers in Obbu, Golbo and Uran are 20-25%, 20-25% and 15 -20%.The proposed intervetion is in tandem with Marsabit County goverment's efforts to intervene through cash transfer through an ongoing drought which is deteriorating in a multifacted approach.The project will involve sub counties' streering groups and NDMA social safety nets database in identifications of the most vulnerablehouseholds of the affected population in both Moyale and Laisamis sub counties. In both target sub counties, community leaders, local admnistration and target communities will be further engaged through public barazas/ meetings in identifications of the most vulnerable households who are not currrently enrolled under any social safety net intervention support either through goverment or other non govermental actors.
